why: A field u.nick?: string is stored as Pres<string> (missing, undefined, or a value) and read as Option<string>; a parameter by?: number is an Option<int>. display writes ?? as a presence test and reads the field again after it: narrowed, the read marks the world if it finds no value, and the lemma shows it does not (proved); greeting changes the default (unproved, WITNESS when the nickname is absent); pad tests the absent amount first (proved); forget and visit are untouched (proved).
